_comment: Widget registry — the single source of truth for addressable widgets (design/widget-system.md, 'First-Class Widgets'). Read by JS hosts (fetch) and Rust (include_str!). System trust tier ONLY: every page here ships in the app bundle; content-tier widgets (artifacts) never appear in this file and open via open_artifact_widget instead. `kind` is the name users, the hub launcher, and the agent all use; `description` is written for the agent directory (Phase 3).

widgets.title: Luna
widgets.description: The Luna conversation — chat with Luna, attachments, voice, artifacts and workflows

widgets.title: Settings
widgets.description: The settings launcher — lists every settings panel

widgets.title: Updates
widgets.description: Check for Luna Moon app updates and install them

widgets.title: General
widgets.description: General preferences: always on top, close on click away, the global shortcut, fresh thread

widgets.title: Appearance
widgets.description: Watercolor palette, light/dark theme, panel chrome style, and paper grain texture — changes apply to every open Luna window instantly

widgets.title: Connection
widgets.description: Server connection: channel (stable/dev), model choice, WebSocket URL and auth token, setup wizard

widgets.title: Voice
widgets.description: Voice settings: voice mode (off, push-to-talk, hands-free), spoken replies, TTS voice, silence timing, speech model

widgets.title: Models
widgets.description: Model routing: configure providers, API key references, and per-role model preference lists

widgets.title: Vault
widgets.description: Secrets vault: stored credentials, add API keys and 1Password service-account tokens, 1Password sync

widgets.title: Skills
widgets.description: Enable, disable and search the agent skills the server offers

widgets.title: Connectors
widgets.description: Connect external services (Google Workspace and others): add accounts, authorize, manage instances

widgets.title: Apps
widgets.description: Your widgets and MCP apps: open, create, edit and remove the panels Luna built or you authored

widgets.title: Now
widgets.description: The live rail: running and waiting jobs, with answer cards when Luna needs the user's input

widgets.title: Briefing
widgets.description: While-you-were-away digest: jobs needing attention, recent runs, upcoming schedules

widgets.title: Workflows
widgets.description: The workflow gallery: every scheduled and on-demand job with status, schedule and last/next run — click one for its run history

widgets.title: Run history
widgets.description: Run history inspector for one workflow/job (open with params {jobId})

widgets.title: Agents
widgets.description: Live view of the subagent team working on a chat turn (opens with params {thread})

widgets.title: Suggested Actions
widgets.description: Suggested actions proposed by Luna for the active conversation (opens with params {thread})
